lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nb6Fe2 (reduced formula Nb3Fe) crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Fe and Nb centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Fe is surrounded by 12 Nb at 2.5277 Å, while Nb has 4 Fe and 8 Nb neighbors at the same distance. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Nb-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Fe- and Nb-centered polyhedra.
